decision.explanation: Documents d00, d01, and d03 explicitly identify George Brodrick (specifically the 3rd Viscount Midleton, father of the 4th Viscount) as dying on 22 August 1765, whereas document d02 attributes the 1770 date to a different entry or contains conflicting metadata regarding the 3rd Viscount, and documents d03-d06 refer to his son (4th Viscount) or a later descendant (George Charles Brodrick).
